cases.prompt: Edit this project update for clear, concise plain language. Preserve my direct tone and every factual qualification.
expect: The revision leads with the useful information and removes repetition or unsupported importance claims.
Voice, facts, qualifications, and required terminology are preserved.
The edited text is the primary output.

cases.prompt: Implement the API endpoint and update its README example.
expect: The implementation task is not rerouted into a general prose-editing workflow merely because documentation changes.

cases.prompt: Make this contract clause shorter, but keep its defined terms and legal effect exactly intact.
expect: Defined terms and legal distinctions are preserved.
The agent asks only if shortening would materially change legal meaning.
No blanket word or punctuation ban drives the edit.
